text: Independent review: APPROVE for aspect-viewport scope at dd31fd6f0d3b06ce18769353829d63f9993f3eb6. Complete relevant placement/frame/clipping/type-contract paths reviewed; no blocking findings. Twelve actual rendered Fit/Fill cases at 400x300 and 333x777, with top/centre/bottom placement, passed JavaFX Canvas, Java2D PNG and Chromium SVG checks. Analytic content-frame/bounds checks and twelve native/device centre round trips passed. Every fixture visually inspected; comparison sheets and critique in .agent-work/raster-aspect-review/README.md; exact hashes/dimensions in provenance.json; machine evidence pixel-report.json. Alpha bounds permit one edge pixel of backend coverage differences, not whole-frame pixel identity. Rendered cases use horizontal centre alignment; left/right slack is unit-tested. Headless software JavaFX and Chromium 140 at DPR1; physical desktop/GPU/HiDPI, other backends/readers and all rotation combinations are outside this evidence. Main advanced during review; this verdict is bound to dd31fd6, separate from the owner's later cc31574 integration/closure evidence. No production changes or status changes made by reviewer.
